faqs.q: Where and how are the Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders used?
faqs.a: The Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders open a flange joint for gasket change or inspection, in mechanical and hydraulic sets. The listing has 12 models from 8.7 to 26.9 ton, each with a stated maximum spread of 4 or 4.1 in. This listing carries 12 part numbers.

faqs.q: What sizes and part numbers are listed for the Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders?
faqs.a: The listing carries 12 part numbers in three capacities: 8.7 ton, 15.7 ton and 26.9 ton, with a maximum spread of 4 in on the 8.7 ton sets and 4.1 in on the others. Part numbers such as SWI5TES, SWI1214TMSTDEX and SWI2025TEMAXSPB cover mechanical, external hydraulic and integral hydraulic sets.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size or model of the Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders?
faqs.a: Choose the capacity, 8.7, 15.7 or 26.9 ton, then the type: mechanical, external hydraulic or integral hydraulic. Single and twin sets, and Mini, Standard and Maxi sets, are listed for the 8.7 and 26.9 ton models, so match the set to the flange gap you need to open.

faqs.q: What pressure rating do the Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders have?
faqs.a: The maker states a capacity or spread for each model of the Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders in the size table, and the rating depends on the model and the pump or torque you drive it with. Use only the model whose stated capacity and maximum spread cover the job, and never exceed the stated figure.

faqs.q: What are the Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders made from?
faqs.a: The listing does not state the materials of the Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders. Flange tools wedge or push against flange faces and bolts, so ask us for the maker's data on the model you want if you need material or surface-finish details.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders?
faqs.a: The listing marks some SWi models as ATEX certified, such as SWI5TEET variants with an EX suffix like SWI1214TMSTDEX and SWI2025TEMAXEX, and others as standard sets. No certificate is held on the listing, so ask in the enquiry for the ATEX documentation of the part number you want.

faqs.q: Which parts do the Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders mate with?
faqs.a: The Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders work between the faces of a flange joint or across the bolt holes, so the tool must fit the flange size and gap. Check the maximum spread or the flange size range against the joint before ordering, and see [our flange tools shelf](/c/flange-spreaders-alignment-tools) for the other tool types.

faqs.q: How should the Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: Before using the Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders, check the wedge or ram for wear, keep the pump pressure within the tool's rating and keep hands clear of the flange gap, because a spread flange stores energy. Open the flange only as far as the job needs and support the pipe on both sides.

faqs.q: Where are the Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders used?
faqs.a: The Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders are used in maintenance and shutdown work on pipework, pressure vessels and wind turbine towers to open, align or face flange joints, especially in plants where hot work is restricted.

faqs.q: How do the Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders differ from the Enerpac SG series flange spreading kits?
faqs.a: The SWi range is listed in 8.7, 15.7 and 26.9 ton sets with a maximum spread of 4 to 4.1 in and ATEX versions, while [the Enerpac SG series flange spreading kits](/p/enerpac-sg-series-flange-spreading-kits) covers mechanical and hydraulic spreading kits with maximum spreads of 2.95 to 4.72 in. Choose SWi where an ATEX-certified spreader is required.

faqs.q: What country of origin and HS code apply to the Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders?
faqs.a: We ship the Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders from our Dubai, UAE warehouse to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. The country of origin depends on the plant that made the batch and is stated on the commercial invoice. Export documents come with the order; ask on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.a: Yes, the Enerpac Equalizer SWi flange spreaders are held in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and we ship worldwide with the best lead times. Quote the part numbers you need on [our contact page](/contact).
